summary: The dossiers match CURRENT FACTS on roster, coach, dates and the Specter reveal, and the strategy's 16-3 run adds up. The 1973 clincher was a Game 5 road win at the Forum in Inglewood. An earlier version of this check wrongly moved it to the Garden; corrected Oct 10, 2026. Karl-Anthony Towns's father was wrongly called a Dominican national-team player, and that is still wrong in strategy.json. Five invented or stale details were removed. The biggest open risks are retail doors, Kith and Frazier's status, the City Edition behind 'Fence Line', park-tournament operators and Tyshawn Jones's sponsor.
